title: Report: Eagles to move Cam Jurgens to guard, Drew Kendall to start at center

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Eagles to move Cam Jurgens to guard, Drew Kendall to start at center
sources.description: Eagles offensive coordinator Sean Mannion said this week that the team would keep any plans for replacing left guard Landon Dickerson in-house, including whether moving center Cam Jurgens to the spot was a consideration.
